==Quests==
* {{questlong|Alliance|42|A Bloody Solution}} {{queststartfinish}}
* {{questlong|Alliance|45D|Ravencroft's Ambition}} {{queststartfinish}}

==Quotes==
I would love to see the final version of Ur's research, but unfortunately his final books are not in our possession. We must settle for his messy, half-finished ideas and notes instead. His works may make little sense now, but perhaps Moranna can see what we cannot.

In the meantime, we will provide as much aid as we can to those in need, as she did for us - the Lupine Coven.
